title: EvalSuite
description: A named, versioned set of cases with a declared job. The kind field is load-bearing: a suite small enough to run in seconds cannot certify a promotion, and a suite large enough to certify one cannot gate every change. Conflating them yields either a suite nobody runs or a promotion nobody can justify.

kind.description: smoke gates every change and must run offline in seconds. anchor alone may certify a promotion and must satisfy the sizing requirement below. adversarial holds seeded perturbations of another suite.

resolution.description: What difference this suite can actually detect. Well-foundedness of the grading order is satisfied vacuously by an uninformative anchor: resolving a true gap of delta at one-sided confidence 1-epsilon needs roughly z^2/(2*delta^2) items, which is about 3400 for two percentage points at 95%. A suite that does not declare its resolution cannot be read as evidence of no-change.

derived_from.description: For adversarial suites: the suite these cases perturb.
